title: Tyler's machine room and ideas for biomedical inventions

tellings.quote: he says that he goes to a room where there's a machine and he doesn't know exactly what the machine does but he gets a lot of ideas about biomedical Innovations and goes on to actually start companies that are super successful

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with Diana Pasulka about her book American Cosmic, retells what a man called Tyler says in it. According to Michels, Tyler says he goes to a room with a machine he doesn't fully understand, connected in the telling to a secret US space programme, and comes away with ideas for biomedical inventions, meaning new medical technology. Michels says Tyler then started companies that became very successful, which, if true, would mean real businesses grew out of that strange room.
